name: Valkama Foods Oy
business: Food manufacturer with four production lines. Washdown (wet cleaning) areas, so enclosure rating IP54 is the minimum.

contacts.name: Teemu Hakala
contacts.style: Short, informal messages. Says 'urgent' about almost everything. Says 'bigger' or 'stronger' about power, not physical size. Rarely gives part numbers.

contacts.name: Sari Niemi
contacts.style: Precise. Quotes part numbers and PO references. Cares about price and delivery date.

installed_base.notes: Profinet module, IP54, motor upsized from 7.5 kW to 11 kW in 2021

history.text: Ordered PD-FC-075 with EMC filter for Line 1 mixer.
Ordered spare control board for PD-FC-075.
Teemu wrote 'need a stronger drive for the mixer'. Anna phoned: the mixer motor was being upsized from 7.5 kW to 11 kW. Shipped PD-FC-110 together with a Profinet module.
Teemu: 'URGENT, line is down.' PD-FC-040 shipped overnight.
Teemu wrote 'URGENT' again but it was a planned shutdown two weeks later. Anna's note: Teemu says urgent for everything, always ask if the line is down.
PD-FC-040 out of stock. PD-FC-045 offered as substitute and accepted.
IP20 variant offered to save cost. Rejected by Sari: washdown area, IP54 minimum.
Ordered PD-FC-040 for Line 4 packaging line.
